title: Partner Rental Program Terms: Weekly and Monthly Billing Blocks
content:
**Rate convention.** The covered days of a partner direct-bill rental under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement are turned into billable days by the partner's rate convention. The invoice is paid on its billable days.

| Covered days of the rental | How the days are billed |
|---|---|
| 28 or more | In blocks of 28 days, each block billed as 22 days. The remaining days are billed one by one. |
| 7 to 27 | In blocks of 7 days, each block billed as 6 days. The remaining days are billed one by one. |
| Fewer than 7 | Day by day for the covered days |

The convention applies to a rental whose authorization shows it as a partner direct-bill rental. A rental of any other kind is billed day by day for its covered days.

Days left over after the blocks are not regrouped. With 28 or more covered days, the days beyond the 28-day blocks are billed one by one, even when seven or more of them remain.

## Billable days for sample lengths (hypothetical partner direct-bill rentals)

| Covered days | Blocks | Billable days |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | None | 5 |
| 6 | None | 6 |
| 7 | One 7-day block | 6 |
| 13 | One 7-day block plus 6 days | 12 |
| 14 | Two 7-day blocks | 12 |
| 20 | Two 7-day blocks plus 6 days | 18 |
| 27 | Three 7-day blocks plus 6 days | 24 |
| 28 | One 28-day block | 22 |
| 30 | One 28-day block plus 2 days | 24 |
| 35 | One 28-day block plus 7 days | 29 |
